function convert(value: string | symbol) {
  console.log('value: ' + value);
  console.log(`${value}`);
}
function remove(value: { a: string | null; b: number | null; c: void }) {
  delete value.a;
  delete value.b;
  delete value.c;
}
class Example {}
function testInstance(x: string | number, y: boolean | number) {
  console.log(x instanceof Example);
  console.log(y instanceof Example);
}
